name: plantim-icons-workspace
description: Plantim open-source cross-platform semantic icon library workspace.

scripts.icons:generate: node design-tokens/bin/generate-icons.mjs && node design-tokens/bin/generate-swift-icons.mjs && npm --prefix packages/plantim-icons run build
scripts.icons:validate:node: npm run icons:generate && npm run icons:check && npm run icons:test && npm run icons:accessibility && npm run icons:galleries && npm run icons:package:check && npm run icons:package:api && npm run icons:package:size
scripts.icons:validate: npm run icons:validate:node && swift test --package-path packages/PlantimIcons
